subject: website
name: Merkle Japan
summary: The site of Merkle Japan, with study programs and events. No public source for the site was confirmed. It is Level 2: it loads the Tailwind script from cdn.tailwindcss.com with no integrity hash, embeds a Google Forms frame as the page opens, and loads Google Fonts.

connections.name: Tailwind CDN script (cdn.tailwindcss.com)
connections.note: Loaded when the page opens, no integrity hash.

connections.name: Google Forms embed (forms.gle, docs.google.com)
connections.note: A frame loaded as the page opens.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
